title: Acceptance ALU, 8-bit combinational
behavior: Unsigned 8-bit ALU: op 0 ADD, 1 SUB, 2 AND, 3 OR, 4 XOR, 5 logical left shift, 6 logical right shift, 7 unsigned less-than. Shifts use b[2:0]. Arithmetic wraps modulo 256. carry is unsigned add carry for ADD, borrow (a < b) for SUB, otherwise zero. zero is (result == 0). No signed overflow flag.
clock_reset: Combinational; no clock, reset, pipeline, enable or handshake.

requirements.text: Implement all eight specified opcodes without latches.
requirements.acceptance: For every opcode compare RTL to an independently derived Python reference on all pairs from {0,1,2,7,8,15,16,127,128,254,255}, then 2048 deterministic seeded operand pairs per opcode. Unit-test reference-model boundaries separately. This is bounded simulation, not exhaustive RTL proof.

requirements.text: Compute carry/borrow and zero exactly as specified for every opcode.
requirements.acceptance: Compare both flags with the reference for every simulated vector, explicitly including wrap, borrow, equal operands and zero.

requirements.text: Only b[2:0] sets the logical shift count; shifted-out bits are discarded.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise all eight counts, high b bits and values 0x00, 0x01, 0x80 and 0xff.
